description: This Java class 'ThingsSseRouteBuilder' constructs Akka HTTP routes for Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoints related to '/things' and '/search' paths, handling authorization, event streaming, and search functionalities within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ThingsSseRouteBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for creating SSE routes for '/things' and '/search' endpoints, managing authorization, event streaming, and search functionalities.

classes.name: NoOpSseAuthorizationEnforcer
classes.description: Null implementation of SseAuthorizationEnforcer that performs no authorization checks.

classes.name: NoOpSseConnectionSupervisor
classes.description: Null implementation of SseConnectionSupervisor that performs no supervision actions.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ThingsSseRouteBuilder with provided streaming actor, config, and pub-sub mediator.

methods.name: withAuthorizationEnforcer
methods.description: Sets a custom authorization enforcer for SSE routes.

methods.name: withEventSniffer
methods.description: Sets a custom event sniffer for SSE events.

methods.name: withSseConnectionSupervisor
methods.description: Sets a custom supervisor for SSE connections.

methods.name: withSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Sets a signal enrichment provider.

methods.name: withProxyActor
methods.description: Sets a proxy actor for search SSE routes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the combined SSE routes for '/things' and '/search' paths.

methods.name: buildThingsSseRoute
methods.description: Creates SSE route for '/things' endpoint with parameters.

methods.name: createSseRoute
methods.description: Creates SSE route for '/things' with filtering, authorization, and streaming setup.

methods.name: createSearchSseRoute
methods.description: Creates SSE route for '/search' endpoint with search parameters and proxy handling.

methods.name: postprocess
methods.description: Post-processes JSONifiable objects, enriching and filtering them before streaming.

methods.name: namespaceMatches
methods.description: Checks if event namespace matches provided list.

methods.name: targetThingIdMatches
methods.description: Checks if event's entity ID matches target IDs.

methods.name: toNonemptyThingJson
methods.description: Converts a Thing and event into JSON, filtering out empty results.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Parses comma-separated namespace string into list.

methods.name: getThingIds
methods.description: Parses comma-separated string into list of ThingId objects.

methods.name: getFieldSelector
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldSelector from string.

methods.name: namespaceFromId
methods.description: Extracts namespace from a ThingEvent's entity ID.

methods.name: newAcceptHeaderExtractor
methods.description: Creates a partial function to extract Accept headers for text event streams.

methods.name: matchesTextEventStream
methods.description: Checks if Accept header matches 'text/event-stream' media type.

methods.name: getCounterFor
methods.description: Creates a metrics counter for SSE message counting with specific path tag.
